When you need a smile

A tiny reminder for a long day.

Kittu, unclench your jaw, take a breath, and give today a little less power over you. One difficult day does not get to define your whole life. Go find a song you love or something delicious to eat. You deserve a small happy thing.
🌷

When you doubt yourself

Read this slowly, please.

You don't have to be the strongest, prettiest, most productive, or most put-together version of yourself every day. You are allowed to be a work in progress. I hope you offer yourself the same kindness you offer the people you care about.
☾

When the world feels loud

A little quiet corner.

Imagine a winter night, your favourite song playing softly, and a sky full of stars. Nothing needs to be solved in this exact second. Take a little break, breathe, and come back when you're ready. Rest is allowed, Kittu.
08 ♡ the words behind the website

One letter for Kittu. 💜

A little letter folded into this corner of the internet. Open it when you're ready.

For Kittu, on her birthday♡

Dear Kittu,

Happy birthday to my favourite Kittu.

I wanted to make you something you could explore instead of sending you another ordinary birthday message. We have not met face-to-face yet, but I still wanted to celebrate the person I have got to know through a screen. So I collected the little things you love and tucked them into this tiny corner of the internet. It might be a little cheesy, maybe a little dramatic, but it was made with care, and that part is very real.

I hope this next year brings you closer to the places you dream about, from Japan to New York; gives you more reasons to look up at starry skies; and fills your ordinary days with flowers, good food, ridiculous laughter, and people who make you feel safe being completely yourself.

You don't have to be perfect to be special to the people who care about you. You can be unpredictable, soft, stubborn, messy, quiet, loud, every different version of you. I hope you never feel like you have to shrink yourself to make other people comfortable.

Thank you for being part of my life, even from a screen away. I am glad our paths crossed online, and I hope this little website gives you even a fraction of the happiness you deserve. Until we get to meet in person someday, I hope this small gift reminds you that your online bestie is cheering for you from their own little corner of the world.

Happy birthday, Kittu. I hope 2 November is full of the little things you love, and I hope the whole year after it is kinder, brighter, and full of wonderful surprises.

With lots of love,
your favourite human (probably)

Take your time. This bit is meant to be read slowly.

Before you publish, replace the sign-off with your name and add one real memory or inside joke. That detail will make this letter yours.

one last little thing

Happy Birthday,
Kittu.

You are loved. You are worth celebrating. And somewhere in this enormous world, there is someone who is genuinely glad you exist. Happy birthday, Kittu. ♡
